title: A note from Amy
text:
BEFORE YOU BEGIN
A note from Amy
Welcome to Faithfully Found.
This is not a planner for getting more done. It is a place to come back
to what is true.
For the next 90 days, you will walk through four movements: Faith,
Healing, Purpose, and Legacy. Some pages will feel easy. Some will
ask more of you. Let them. The honest answers are usually the ones
God uses first.
You do not have to write perfectly. You do not have to feel deeply
every day. You only have to show up with enough courage to tell the
truth, enough stillness to listen, and enough faith to believe God can
meet you in the middle of ordinary life.
Bring the pain you have carried. Bring the questions you have
avoided. Bring the dream you keep minimizing. Bring the part of you
that still wants to believe there is more.
You are not lost here. You are being found.
Amy

title: How to use this journal
text:
YOUR DAILY RHYTHM
How to use this journal
SHOW UP DAILY Choose a time you can return to without making it
complicated. Consistency will carry you further than
intensity.
TELL THE TRUTH These pages are not a performance. Write what is real,
even if it feels unfinished.
READ SLOWLY Do not rush past the Scripture to get to the prompts.
Let the Word speak before you start explaining your
life.
ANSWER EVERY PROMPT The first answer may be obvious. The third answer
often reaches the place you have been avoiding.
FINISH THE
REFLECTION One sentence can anchor what God showed you that
day. Keep it simple and specific.
RETURN AND READ
AGAIN Come back to old entries. You may see evidence of
God’s faithfulness that you missed while you were
living it.

title: A prayer before you begin
text:
A prayer before you begin
Lord, I come to these pages with open hands.
I do not have every answer. I do not know what You will reveal
over these 90 days. I only know that You are kind, You are faithful,
and You are already here.
Thank You for the gift of this day. Thank You for grace that covers
the places where I have fallen short. Thank You for loving the
parts of me I am still learning how to bring into the light.
As I write, teach me. As I listen, heal me. As I surrender, shape me.
Quiet the noise of fear, shame, striving, and doubt. Let Your voice
become clearer than every voice that has tried to name me
without knowing me.
I am faithfully found because You found me first.
Amen.

title: Faith: the first movement
text:
WEEKS 1-3 · DAYS 1-20
Faith
Rooting yourself in what you believe.
Before you build anything new, return to the foundation. Faith
is not a decorative part of your life. It is the ground beneath
your healing, your calling, your business, your family, and the
legacy you are becoming responsible for.
This first section is an invitation to remember who God is, who
He says you are, and what becomes possible when you stop
trying to carry everything alone.

title: Day 01: Who God Says I Am
text:
FAITHFULLY FOUND
DAY 01 · FAITH
Who God Says I Am
PSALM 139:14
I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
Begin here: before the goals, before the healing work, before the next
assignment, before the legacy you are building. God does not start with
what you produce. He starts with who you are. Today is about receiving
identity before you try to prove it.
1 Write down five truths God says about you. Which one is hardest for you
to believe today?
2 What would change in the way you move through your day if you fully
received that truth?
3 Write a prayer asking God to help you stop arguing with the identity He
has already spoken over you.
